item.description:
### 新功能
- **三指切換同一個 App 的視窗**：視窗鎖定時三指往左右滑，框會在同一個 App 的視窗之間移動，放開手指就把它拉到最前面，游標也跟著過去 - 教學新增「切換視窗」的練習和示範
### 改進
- 分隔線只在你正在使用那組排版時才會出現，切到別的 App 後經過 Dock 附近不會再誤跳出來 - 按住分隔線時，兩側被其他 App 蓋住的視窗會一起跳到最前面 - 拖曳分隔線碰到 App 的最小尺寸（例如 Finder）會停住，四格排版不再有視窗脫隊 - 修正：用三指切換器切到別的 App 後，置頂的視窗會被取消置頂
### New
- **Switch between an app's windows with three fingers**: with a window locked, swipe three fingers left or right to move the ring through that app's windows, then lift to bring the ringed one forward — the pointer follows - The tutorial now covers switching windows, with a practice step and a demo
### Improved
- The divider only appears for the layout you are working in, so it no longer pops up when the pointer passes near the Dock in another app - Grabbing a divider brings every window on both sides to the front, even ones buried under another app - Dragging a divider stops where an app will not shrink any further (Finder, for one), so no window in a four-way layout drifts off the line - Fixed: switching apps with the three-finger switcher could unpin a pinned window
